name: Putuo District

routes.outcome: Official Putuo government page loaded. It identifies the Putuo Real Estate Registration Center under the district Natural Resources and Planning Sub-bureau and states that it performs cadastral and property-rights surveys, database construction and updates, and registration-material query management for the Putuo area. No parcel API or geometry was exposed.

Live HTML retrieval independently confirmed the page title, content source, local custodian, and the safe scope of the published duties. No JavaScript viewer or parcel-service configuration was present in the inspected page.

Official Putuo spatial-plan PDF loaded. It defines the Putuo administrative planning area and describes a land-space planning one-map supervision system and basic information platform, but provides no anonymous cadastral parcel endpoint, safe parcel identity, or parcel geometry.

Request timed out after 20 seconds from the research host. Treated as an access limitation; not evidence of citywide absence. No retry with credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, or TLS weakening was attempted.
Official Zhoushan notice confirms online immovable-property registration procedures covering Dinghai and Putuo, but it is a procedure notice rather than a public parcel-vector service.
Official Zhoushan government plan describes construction of a natural-resources registration information database and data sharing, but exposes no anonymous Putuo parcel query or geometry route.

schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: No parcel geometry response obtained; CRS and coordinate order remain unverified for a Putuo parcel source.

localCustodianAssessment: The Putuo Real Estate Registration Center, under the Putuo District Natural Resources and Planning Sub-bureau, is evidenced as the local cadastral/registration custodian. Zhoushan municipal materials are higher-level procedure and database-planning evidence, not evidence of a city-bounded public parcel layer.

qualification.reason: No anonymous parcel geometry or city-bounded public vector response was verified; a serial reviewer would need to independently qualify a real source before runtime consideration.
